text:
Annual diabetes review.

HbA1c 8.4%, was 7.1% a year ago. He admits he stopped the metformin in the summer because of
diarrhoea and did not tell anyone.

Feet: pulses present, monofilament intact both sides, no ulceration. Retinal screening up to
date, last grading R0M0.

BP 142/88 on two readings today.

No history of stroke or TIA. No angina. Never smoked.

Asthma is stable. Salbutamol maybe twice a month, no oral steroids in the last two years.

Restarted metformin MR 500 mg od with a plan to titrate. If the HbA1c is still above 8% in three
months we will add an SGLT2 inhibitor.

ED 02:15. Wheeze.

Two days of coryza then wheeze from midnight. Peak flow 320, best 520. Sats 96% on air. RR 22.
No accessory muscle use, talking in full sentences.

Salbutamol 10 mg neb with ipratropium. Prednisolone 40 mg po.

Reassessed at 04:00: peak flow 470, chest quiet, comfortable.

Type 2 diabetes - warned that the steroids will push his sugars up over the next week and told
to test more often.

Home with 5 days of prednisolone and follow up with the asthma nurse. Written asthma plan given.
